nodes.name: .fallowrc.json
nodes.summary: Fallow dead-code analyzer configuration. Defines entry points (src/index.*, src/main.*), sets duplicate-detection minOccurrences=3, enables unused-dependencies warning, and specifies 11 ignoreExports rules for Svelte components and constants whose exports are consumed at runtime but invisible to static analysis.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON with comments (JSONC). References src/lib/constants.ts, 8 Svelte components in ignoreExports.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: AI agent context document for the voxlblade-builder project. Describes project overview (Svelte 5 + Vite + TypeScript damage calculator for Voxel Blade), directory structure (src/lib/engine, src/lib/data, src/lib/ui, src/routes), dev workflow (pnpm install/dev/test/build/lint/format), and agent interaction guidelines.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown. Documents project structure, tech stack, and testing conventions.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project README. Template-based Svelte+TS+Vite boilerplate readme explaining IDE setup (VS Code + Svelte extension), why this over SvelteKit, TypeScript configuration rationale (global.d.ts vs compilerOptions.types), HMR state preservation caveats, and a writable store example.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown with embedded TypeScript code snippet demonstrating Svelte writable store usage.

nodes.name: build-decode.txt
nodes.summary: Build-share decode output containing a numeric prefix (398) and a JSON-encoded Voxel Blade character build with race (ORK), guild (Monk), gear level (3), corruption amount (0), equipment slots (helmet, cape, leggings, ring, rune, items, weapon parts, gloves, shield, mount), and corrupted/truncated data at the end.
nodes.languageNotes: Plain text. Contains malformed JSON at end (truncated shield/mount fields).

nodes.name: build-decode2.json
nodes.summary: Second attempt at decoding the same build-share string. Contains the identical character build JSON (ORK Monk, level 3, same equipment) but truncated/corrupted at the same shield field. Likely a manual re-extraction.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON (invalid). Truncated at shield field with garbled characters.

nodes.name: fallow-output.json
nodes.summary: Fallow dead-code analysis report (v2.102.0, schema 7). Found 28 issues in 859ms across 4 entry points: 1 unused file (svelte.config.js), 23 unused exports (in src/data/Boost.ts, src/data/Runebasedmg.ts, src/data/defensivePerks.ts, src/data/draconicColorEffects.ts, src/data/raceEffects.ts, src/data/weaponConditionalBoosts.ts, src/lib/defense.ts, src/lib/engine.ts), 2 unused types, 2 duplicate exports.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON. 782 lines. Contains per-issue metadata with file paths, line numbers, column offsets, and auto-fix actions.

nodes.name: fallow-security.json
nodes.summary: Fallow security analysis report (v2.102.0, schema 7). Configured rules (security_client_server_leak, security_sink) are off but effective as warn. Contains multiple tainted-sink findings: dangerous-html (CWE-79) via template.innerHTML in DidYouMean.svelte, SuggestDrop.svelte, and App.svelte; dynamic-regex (CWE-1333) via new RegExp() in App.svelte. All rated low severity, not reachable from untrusted sources.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON. 1391 lines. Contains finding IDs, CWE references, severity ratings, reachability analysis, and suppression actions.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Vite SPA entry point. Sets up the HTML document with charset, viewport meta, Font Awesome 4.7 CDN stylesheet, page title 'VoxlBlade Builder', an empty #app mount point, and loads /src/main.ts as an ES module.
nodes.languageNotes: HTML5. Loads Font Awesome from cdnjs.cloudflare.com. Module script for Vite HMR.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Project manifest for 'voxlblade'. ES module, private. Scripts: dev, build, preview, check (svelte-check + tsc), test (vitest). DevDependencies: Svelte 5.55, Vite 8, TypeScript 6, ESLint 10, Fallow 2.104, Playwright, rollup-plugin-visualizer, vite-plugin-pwa, vitest 4. Runtime dependency: @vercel/analytics.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON. 32 lines. Uses pnpm (lockfile references). TypeScript ~6.0.2, Svelte ^5.55.4.

nodes.name: stats-data.json
nodes.summary: Rollup/bundle visualizer data file (schema version 2). Contains a hierarchical tree of built assets starting from a single output chunk (assets/index-uX8wi3fo.js), with children for rolldown runtime, Vite helpers, Svelte internals, and project source modules.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON. Single line. 4950-line stats.html references this inline (different build hash).

nodes.name: stats.html
nodes.summary: Self-contained Rollup Visualizer HTML report (4950 lines). Embeds the rollup-plugin-visualizer Svelte-based treemap app with inline CSS (dark theme), d3-hierarchy layout engine, and the complete bundle tree data. Renders an interactive sunburst/treemap chart of module sizes.
nodes.languageNotes: HTML with inline CSS and ~4900 lines of inline JavaScript (Svelte-compiled bundle visualizer).

nodes.languageNotes: Plain text. 0 lines. Generated/used by build or check scripts.

nodes.name: tsconfig.app.json
nodes.summary: Application TypeScript configuration. Extends @tsconfig/svelte. Targets ES2023, ESNext modules, enables allowJs + checkJs for .svelte and .js files, moduleDetection force, noEmit. Includes src/**/*.ts|js|svelte.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON. 20 lines. Types: svelte, vite/client. Build info in node_modules/.tmp.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Root TypeScript configuration. Single-line file that extends tsconfig.app.json with no overrides. Serves as the default tsconfig for editor tooling and IDE integration.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON. 3 lines. Purely a re-export of tsconfig.app.json.

nodes.name: tsconfig.node.json
nodes.summary: Node/build-tool TypeScript configuration. Targets ES2023 with ESNext modules, bundler moduleResolution, Node types. Strict linting: noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters, erasableSyntaxOnly, noFallthroughCasesInSwitch. Includes only vite.config.ts.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON. 24 lines. Uses allowImportingTsExtensions, verbatimModuleSyntax, noEmit.

nodes.name: vercel.json
nodes.summary: Vercel deployment configuration. Build command: npm run build, output: dist, framework: vite. Sets cache headers: immutable 1-year for /assets/*, must-revalidate for /sw.js and /index.html. Service worker support indicates PWA (via vite-plugin-pwa).
nodes.languageNotes: JSON. 34 lines. Three cache-control header rules for static assets, SW, and HTML.
